units.text: 根据您提供的信息，国家召唤服役计划（National Call to Service）的资格要求如下：您必须完成初始入伍训练，随后在国防部长指定的军事职业专业中继续服役15个月，并且在没有服役中断的情况下，再服役一段额外的现役期或在选定预备役部队中保持现役状态24个月。
supporting_chunk_ids: National Call To Service Program | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The eligibility requirements are directly stated in the context.

units.text: 之后，您还需完成剩余的服役义务，方式包括在武装部队服现役、在选定预备役部队服役、在个人待命预备役服役，或在美国志愿队等国内国家服务计划中服务。
supporting_chunk_ids: National Call To Service Program | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The ways to complete remaining service are listed in the context.

units.text: 如果您符合这些条件，您可以选择以下福利之一：5,000美元现金奖励、不超过18,000美元的学贷偿还、相当于3年期月度MGIB标准12个月的教育援助，或相当于不足3年期月度MGIB标准50%的36个月教育援助。
supporting_chunk_ids: National Call To Service Program | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The benefit options are listed in the context.

units.text: 请注意，此计划由退伍军人事务部（VA）代表国防部管理，且可能影响您的服役合同。
supporting_chunk_ids: National Call To Service Program | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states the program is administered by VA on behalf of DoD and may affect service contract.

units.text: 如果您尚未完成国家服役，建议联系您的招募人员了解具体资格和注册事宜。
supporting_chunk_ids: National Call To Service Program | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context advises contacting a recruiter for eligibility and enrollment.
